thesisQuality.note: Record trading-volume share plus rapid subscription/services diversification support durable adoption, but normalized-cycle durability remains unproven.

financialOperatingMomentum.note: Fourteen consecutive positive Adjusted EBITDA quarters, record share and narrowed expense guidance support strong momentum, tempered by crypto-cycle sensitivity.

marketValuationOpportunity.note: September 2026 market cap around $43.4B remains demanding against uncertain normalized-cycle earnings; evidence does not support a compelling-value band.

catalystScore.note: Everything Exchange expansion, Deribit integration and continued product diversification provide identifiable catalysts, with regulatory/integration uncertainty.

governancePower.note: Sustained positive Adjusted EBITDA and expense discipline support adequate-to-strong execution, but current evidence is not sufficient for exceptional stewardship claims.

alignment2036.note: Broadening regulated crypto/onchain infrastructure, stablecoin and derivatives rails gives strong exposure to durable digital-finance infrastructure, while regulatory outcomes remain uncertain.

crossDivisionLeverage.note: Trading, derivatives, subscription/services and onchain infrastructure increasingly reuse the same customer, custody and liquidity rails across distinct demand engines.

bottleneckControl.note: Growing market share, institutional derivatives liquidity and integrated custody/trading rails create meaningful constraint participation, but competing exchanges and decentralized venues prevent exceptional bottleneck treatment.

scenarioRobustness.note: Revenue diversification improves resilience, but transaction economics and regulatory permissions remain materially scenario-dependent.

substitutionResilience.note: Integrated breadth and liquidity raise switching friction, but centralized exchanges, decentralized venues and traditional brokers remain credible substitutes.

supplyChainResilience.note: Digital platform economics avoid physical supply bottlenecks, but current evidence does not establish exceptional redundancy across critical infrastructure/vendors; unknowns are treated conservatively.

pricingPower.note: Market-share gains and diversified subscription/services economics support meaningful value capture, but fee compression and crypto-cycle competition limit a higher band.

risk.note: Material crypto-cycle, regulatory, integration and competitive substitution risks remain despite diversification and positive operating execution.

confidence.note: Identity/tradability and current primary operating evidence are strong, with independent current valuation evidence; confidence is reduced for issuer-heavy operating claims, normalized-cycle economics and undisclosed infrastructure concentration.

thesis: Coinbase is evolving from a cyclical spot brokerage toward diversified crypto/onchain financial infrastructure with growing subscription/services and institutional derivatives exposure; value depends on sustaining liquidity, regulatory permission and diversified economics through weaker crypto cycles.
keyRisk: Regulatory change or crypto-market contraction could compress transaction economics and weaken the integrated-platform thesis before diversification fully offsets cyclicality.
nextCatalyst: Evidence of continued subscription/services growth and Deribit/Everything Exchange integration in subsequent reported quarters.

scoreBreakdown.note: earthScore records the methodology-weighted component score; risk and dataConfidence are separately source-addressed inputs for downstream locked gate treatment.
